description: This strategy aims to capture mean reversion opportunities when price exits Bollinger Bands, confirmed by an oversold RSI and strong buying pressure indicated by Chaikin Money Flow (CMF), within a strong trend as indicated by ADX.
entry_logic: CLOSE < BB_LOWER(20,2) AND RSI(14) < 30 AND CMF(20) > 0 AND ADX(14) > 25
